verses.text: <pb/><t>“Amma yanzu waɗanda na girme su, sai ba'a suke mini,</t> <t>Waɗanda iyayensu maza ba su fi karnukan da suke kiwon garken tumakina ba.</t>
<t>Wace riba zan samu ta wurin ƙarfin hannuwansu waɗanda ba su da sauran kuzari?</t>
<t>Saboda rashi da matsananciyar yunwa sun rame,</t> <t>Sai gaigayar ƙasa suke yi da dare, a cikin kufai.</t>
<t>Sukan tsinki ganyaye masu ɗaci na jeji su ci,</t> <t>Sukan ci doyar jeji.</t>
<t>Aka kore su daga cikin mutane,</t> <t>Suka yi ta binsu da ihu kamar yadda ake yi wa ɓarawo,</t>
<t>Sai a kwazazzabai suke zama</t> <t>Da a ramummuka da kogwannin duwatsu.</t>
<t>Suka yi ta kuka a jeji,</t> <t>Suka taru wuri ɗaya a cikin sarƙaƙƙiya.</t>
<t>Mutane ne marasa hankali marasa suna!</t> <t>Aka kore su daga ƙasar. <pb/></t>
<t>“Yanzu na zama abin waƙa gare su,</t> <t>Abin ba'a kuma a gare su.</t>
<t>Suna ƙyamata, guduna suke yi,</t> <t>Da ganina, sai su tofa mini yau.</t>
<t>Domin Allah ya katse lakata, ya ƙasƙanta ni,</t> <t>Saboda haka sun raba ni da zuriyata,</t>
<t>A hannun dama 'yan tā da zaune tsaye sun taso mini,</t> <t>Sun runtume ni, sun tura ni a hanyarsu ta hallakarwa.</t>
<t>Sun datse hanyata,</t> <t>Sun jawo mini bala'i,</t> <t>Ba kuwa wanda ya hana su.</t>
<t>Sun kutsa kamar waɗanda suka karya doka,</t> <t>Sun auka mini da dukan ƙarfinsu kamar yadda suka yi nufi.</t>
<t>Sun firgita ni,</t> <t>Sun kori darajata kamar da iska,</t> <t>Wadatata kuma ta shuɗe kamar girgije. <pb/></t>
<t>“Yanzu zuciyata ta narke</t> <t>Kwanakin wahala sun same ni.</t>
<t>Da dare ƙasusuwana karkaɗuwa suke,</t> <t>Azaba tana ta gaigayata ba hutawa.</t>
<t>An yi mini kamun kama-karya,</t> <t>An ci wuyan rigata.</t>
<t>Allah ya jefar da ni cikin laka,</t> <t>Na zama kamar ƙura ko toka, <pb/></t>
<t>“Na yi kira gare ka, ya Allah, amma ba ka amsa mini ba,</t> <t>Na yi addu'a kuma, amma ba ka kula da ni ba.</t>
<t>Ka zama mugu a gare ni,</t> <t>Da ƙarfin dantsenka ka tsananta mini.</t>
<t>Ka jefa ni cikin guguwa, ka sa ni in hau ta,</t> <t>Ka yi ta shillo da ni cikin rugugin hadiri.</t>
<t>Hakika na sani za ka kai ni ga mutuwa,</t> <t>Gidan da aka ƙaddara wa kowane mai rai. <pb/></t>
<t>“Ashe, wanda yake gab da gagarumar hallaka,</t> <t>Ba zai miƙa hannu ya roƙi taimako a masifar da yake sha ba?</t>
<t>Ashe, ban yi kuka saboda wanda yake shan wahala ba?</t> <t>Ashe, ban yi ɓacin rai saboda matalauta ba?</t>
<t>Amma sa'ad da na sa zuciya ga alheri, sai ga mugunta,</t> <t>Sa'ad da nake jiran haske, sai ga duhu ya zo.</t>
<t>Zuciyata tana tafasa, ba ta kwanciya,</t> <t>Kwanakin wahala sun auko mini.</t>
<t>Na yanƙwane, amma ba yanƙwanewar rana ba,</t> <t>Na tsaya a gaban taron jama'a, ina roƙon taimako. <pb/></t>
<t>“Na zama ɗan'uwan dila,</t> <t>Na kuma zama aminin jiminai.</t>
<t>Fatata ta takura, ta zama baƙa,</t> <t>Ƙasusuwana suna zogi saboda zafi,</t>
<t>Saboda haka garayata ta zama ta makoki,</t> <t>Sarewata kuma ta zama muryar masu kuka.”</t>
